source: PROSPX Transactions Trade Audit (acq=trade, every row), rebuilt by trade_audit_export.py with the page's own rules
note: One row per real deal the Trade Audit prices. Every value is today's Trade Machine trade value, not the value on the deal date; a party with no trade value counts $0 on his side (mm null, why says why). a_extra and b_extra are the bonus pool and cash the narrative names, credited to the side that received less, as the audit does. The realized leg is WAR for the receiving club since the deal through realized_as_of, priced at dollars_per_war_mm. No verdict is stored: the page applies the shared balanced band.
